integrity: The proof uses the published generalized-quaternion neighborhood structure, a complete true-twin type-profile forcing argument, and an explicit Gram rank witness.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the full cyclic graph of Q_{4n}.
The cyclic-graph decomposition is prior work; the new content is the forcing polynomial, all minimum sets, and exact real minimum rank.
No extension to arbitrary generalized dicyclic groups is asserted.
Minimum rank is over real symmetric graph-pattern matrices.
title: Zero forcing polynomial and minimum rank of generalized-quaternion cyclic graphs
